figures.caption: Fig. 2: Geometric Transformer ( GeoFormer ). (a) Alignment path: GeoFormer predicts a robot-to-ego warp 𝒯 \mathcal{T} and applies 𝒯 − 1 \mathcal{T}^{-1} to align ego observations with the robot view. (b) Warp module: predictors { 𝒢 n } \{\mathcal{G}_{n}\} refine homography parameters to make warped robot images appear natural when composited onto ego images, under adversarial supervision from the critic 𝒞 \mathcal{C} . (c) VLA training: the aligned ego images are used alongside robot observations to train the VLA policy through human–robot co-training.
